name: coreutils-small-04

c_normalization.reason: C2Rust rejects its integer-to-bool cast for bool &= bool. Calling validate_file_name first preserves eager evaluation and the boolean truth table.

c_normalization.expected_before:
if (e == LONGINT_OK && ckd_add (size, tmp_size, 0))
    e = LONGINT_OVERFLOW;
c_normalization.reason: Express the checked uintmax_t-to-size_t assignment explicitly so C2Rust does not infer mixed integer types for ckd_add.
Perform the checked multiplication in intmax_t and explicitly check the off_t range, avoiding C2Rust's incompatible off_t/ptrdiff_t operands.
C2Rust rejects its integer-to-bool cast for bool |= bool. Calling do_ftruncate first preserves eager evaluation and the boolean truth table.

selection_policy: The next measured-smallest independent canonical applet archives after batch three. Base32 is deferred because C2Rust silently deduplicates its shared basenc.c path against base64; comm is substituted. The groups archive has two distinct captured translation units, and both are retained.
